name: Precious Metals Product Prices for WooCommerce
author: nfusionsolutions

sections.description:
Running a precious metals store on WooCommerce means managing product prices that change by the second, staying on top of wholesale premium changes that directly impact your bottom line, and routing time-sensitive orders to your suppliers for fulfillment.

Handling any of those processes manually is a full-time job. Trying to manually keep up with realtime market changes leads to pricing errors, operational bottlenecks, lost margin and brand credibility.

The Precious Metals Product Prices for WooCommerce plugin handles these challenges for you.

Built and maintained by nFusion Solutions, the global technology leader for the precious metals market, this plugin connects your WooCommerce store directly to the nFusion Platform for real-time pricing, seamless product management, and fully automated order fulfillment.

Precious Metals Product Prices for WooCommerce helps precious metals businesses control the workflows that matter most. It is built for bullion dealers, coin shops, wholesalers, and precious metals ecommerce businesses that need to automate those workflows inside WooCommerce.

With one plugin, you can:

  • Update product pricing automatically based on real-time precious metals markets
  • Sync wholesaler premiums with all your metals products on WooCommerce
  • Automate wholesale order flow with drop-shipping support
  • Synchronize products across your enterprise and all sales channels

These features help dealers:

  • Protect margins from rapid market movements
  • Lower pricing risk through reliable automation
  • Reduce manual work using rock solid synchronizations
  • Eliminate stale pricing with always live pricing
  • Operate more efficiently by reducing manual bottlenecks
  • Expand product selection with a scalable platform built for bullion
  • Keep product pages current and reduce manual maintenance
  • Stop carrying unnecessary inventory through effective use of drop-shipping

⚡ Real-Time Precious Metals Pricing for WooCommerce

Manually repricing bullion products is time-consuming and risky. This plugin helps keep your WooCommerce product prices aligned with live market movement so your store can stay competitive while protecting margins.

nFusion has built the most accurate and reliable precious metals data feed in the market, powered by professional-grade data from global exchanges, the same sources trusted by bullion traders worldwide.

Supported Metals: gold, silver, platinum and palladium
Supported Currencies: all major currencies

Pricing features include:

  • Automatic product price updates
  • Fixed-dollar and percentage-based markups
  • Tiered / volume pricing for bulk orders
  • Optional credit card surcharge support in checkout
  • Optional buy back price display
  • Customizable pricing labels
  • Wholesale pricing mode
  • Product variants
  • Multi-currency support

CRITICAL NOTE: Our currency rates and price conversion data is all real-time. Most other plugins and integrators use currency rates that are not real-time, which can create significant price conversion issues.

All product types supported: coins, bars, rounds, semi-numismatics, ingots, jewelry, and specialty items.

📦 Wholesale Order Automation with Drop-Shipping Support

For many bullion dealers, this is the feature that changes the economics of the store.

When a customer places an order in WooCommerce, the plugin can automate the order flow into your wholesale operation for downstream fulfillment. This supports drop-shipping workflows, allowing dealers to list and sell products they do not currently stock and have those products shipped directly to their customers.

This can help you:

  • Expand product selection without carrying all inventory
  • Fulfill more efficiently through wholesale relationships
  • Lower storage and handling costs
  • Reduce capital tied up in stock
  • Lower overhead for operations
  • Speed up order handling

In the bullion space, that can create major cost savings while giving dealers more flexibility to grow.

Order automation features include:

  • Wholesaler premium sync automation for product markups
  • Automatic submission of orders after checkout
  • Accurate pricing from checkout to order workflow
  • Order history and status tracking
  • Support for standard WooCommerce checkout flows
  • Batch processing for efficiency
  • Per-order sync visibility in WooCommerce admin
  • Configurable sync intervals

🔄 Product Sync

Precious metals product offerings can change quickly as new products come on the market and old products are retired. Keeping product data aligned across systems manually can become a major operational burden. This plugin includes a product sync workflow that helps keep WooCommerce and your nFusion Platform data aligned while reducing manual maintenance.

The nFusion Bullion Pricing Engine allows you to easily manage your spot prices, products, and premiums in one convenient place, and from there it is delivered to anywhere you do business: e-commerce store, in-store sales, external marketplaces, mobile apps, and more. This plugin’s Product Sync capability keeps WooCommerce and your nFusion Platform services perfectly aligned.

Sync features include:

  • Bulk Add products to WooCommerce from nFusion Platform
  • Import WooCommerce products into nFusion Platform
  • View sync status at a glance for all products
  • Bulk edit key product attributes
  • Match products between systems by SKU
  • Keep search and filtering indexes up-to-date

This is especially useful for bullion dealers and precious metals ecommerce stores managing larger inventories, broad product selections, or frequent product updates.

Built for Precious Metals Ecommerce

This plugin is designed for businesses that need more than a generic WooCommerce pricing extension.

It is a strong fit for:

  • Bullion dealers
  • Precious metals ecommerce dealers
  • Wholesale precious metals sellers
  • Dealer-facing WooCommerce stores
  • Merchants using drop-shipping fulfillment models
  • Physical coin shops that need live gold and silver pricing

If your business depends on accurate pricing, efficient catalog management, and streamlined order flow, this plugin is built for that environment.

Why Store Owners Choose This Plugin

Store owners typically choose this plugin because it solves three high-impact problems in one place:

  • Real-time pricing accuracy — reduce manual repricing and stale prices
  • Product Management — keep all products in sync across all platforms and sales channels
  • Order automation with drop-shipping support — sell a broader range of products without stocking every item yourself

Why Bullion Dealers Choose nFusion Solutions?

nFusion Solutions is the global technology leader for the precious metals market. Our platform is trusted by dealers, mints, and distributors worldwide.

  • Professional-grade data — powered by accurate, reliable data from global exchanges, the same sources trusted by bullion traders worldwide
  • Market-hours coverage — live spot prices follow the Globex market (Sunday 6:00 PM EST through Friday 5:00 PM EST, with daily 1 hour closures from 5:00–6:00 PM EST)
  • Scales with your business — clients with thousands of products rely on this plugin to reprice every one of them automatically
  • World-class support — all subscribed customers receive ongoing maintenance and access to our support team
  • Onboarding & training — we guide you through setup, configuration, and best practices to maximize every feature

Getting Started

This plugin requires a monthly subscription to the nFusion Solutions platform.

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Contact us to get your API credentials:
    • Phone: 1-888-806-3081 (option #1 for Sales)
    • Email: Sales Team
    • Web: nfusionsolutions.com
  3. Enter your Tenant Alias, Catalog API Key, and (for order sync) Orders API Key in the plugin settings
  4. You’re live

Ready to see how it works for your bullion business? Install the plugin, then contact our team to schedule a demo and start your free trial.

Add Charts, Tickers & Market Data to Your Site

Looking to display live gold and silver price charts, spot price tickers, or historical data tables on your storefront? nFusion offers a full suite of precious metals market data widgets that complement this plugin perfectly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress plugin installer
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to nFusion Settings in the WP Admin sidebar to enter your API credentials
  4. Optional: Install the Action Scheduler plugin to enable background product syncing, product re-indexing, and the retail order sync batch job
sections.faq:
Do I need a subscription to use this plugin?

Yes. The plugin requires an active subscription for live pricing, product sync, and wholesale order automation features. Contact us at 1-888-806-3081 (option #1 for Sales) or Email Sales to get started.

How accurate and reliable is the price data?

nFusion Solutions metals price and currency rates data is powered with professional-grade data feeds. Live spot prices follow the Globex market schedule. For a detailed explanation of our Global Precious Metals Spot prices and how they are derived read our full guide on Precious Metals Spot Prices

How often do product prices update?

By default, prices refresh every 60 seconds. You can configure this interval in the plugin’s Pricing settings tab (minimum 10 seconds).

Who is this plugin for?

It is built for precious metals businesses using WooCommerce, including bullion dealers, coin shops, wholesalers, and stores selling gold, silver, platinum, and palladium products online.

How many products can be automatically priced?

Clients with thousands of WooCommerce products use this plugin to price all of their products automatically in real time. There is no product limit built into the plugin.

Does retail order sync work with manually created admin orders?

Yes. Orders created directly in the WP Admin (without going through the checkout) are fully supported. When the order status is set to Processing, prices are snapshotted from the live Bullion Pricing Engine at that moment and the order is queued for submission.

What checkout flows does the order sync support?

The plugin supports the classic WooCommerce checkout, the Gutenberg block-based checkout, admin-created orders, and orders completed via the WooCommerce customer-pay page (the pending → on-hold → processing flow).

Do I need Action Scheduler for the order sync to work?

Yes. Retail Order Sync uses Action Scheduler to run the batch submission job on a schedule. The product background sync and re-indexing features also require Action Scheduler. This is a free, standalone plugin available on WordPress.org or via WooCommerce.

How does the plugin match WooCommerce products to the nFusion Platform?

The plugin matches products using either the standard WooCommerce SKU field or a dedicated nFusion SKU meta field (nfs_catalog_plugin_sku) on the product. If both are present, the nFusion SKU takes priority. The highlighted SKU on the Product Sync matched table shows which field is actively driving pricing.

Can I use this plugin for wholesale / dealer pricing?

Yes. There is a Wholesale Pricing mode in the Advanced settings tab that switches the plugin to use wholesale prices and tiers from the nFusion API. This mode is only available to accounts with a wholesale subscription.

How can I add charts and spot price widgets to my site?

See our precious metals charts and tickers page for the full range of market data visualization options.

Do I get support and ongoing maintenance?

Yes. All subscribed customers receive ongoing maintenance for subscribed services and access to the nFusion support team. We also provide onboarding training to help you get the most out of every feature.

Does it support live gold and silver pricing?

Yes. The plugin supports automated pricing workflows for gold and silver products, with configurable refresh intervals.

Does it also support platinum and palladium?

Yes. The plugin supports pricing workflows for gold, silver, platinum, and palladium products.

Can I use it for bullion products like coins and bars?

Yes. It is well suited for bullion, coins, bars, rounds, numismatics, and other precious metals products.

Does it support tiered or volume pricing?

Yes. Tiered and volume-based pricing can be configured for eligible products.

Can it show buy prices on product pages?

Yes. Optional buy price display is supported.

Does it support wholesale pricing?

Yes. The plugin includes a wholesale pricing mode for dealer and wholesale workflows.

How does product sync work?

Products are matched by SKU and managed through a sync workflow that helps keep product data aligned between WooCommerce and the nFusion Platform.

What is the main advantage of the order automation feature?

It reduces manual processing and supports wholesale fulfillment workflows, including drop-shipping models that let dealers sell products they do not have to stock themselves.

Why is drop shipping valuable in the bullion industry?

It helps dealers expand product selection, reduce capital tied up in inventory, and lower fulfillment overhead.

Is this suitable for stores with thousands of products?

Yes. The plugin is designed to support thousands of products and includes background processing to efficiently manage sync-related operations.

Does it support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes. The plugin supports modern WooCommerce order storage workflows.

Can I install it and then request a demo?

Yes. Install the plugin, then contact our Sales Team to schedule a demo and start your trial.

Product Management – Centralized product management interface for controlling pricing and managing wholesaler product mappings.
Product Mappings – Configure and manage wholesaler mappings to automatically apply wholesale costs and markups to your retail pricing (COGS).
Per-Product Pricing & Margins – Set fixed or percentage-based markups on individual products to maintain consistent margins.
Retail Orders – View all eligible WooCommerce retail orders that have been successfully sent to the nFusion platform.
Wholesale Orders – Create and manage wholesale orders used to fulfill retail demand.
Retail–Wholesale Order Association – Easily track which wholesale orders are linked to and fulfilling specific retail orders.
Product Sync Status – Monitor which products are synced with the nFusion platform and eligible for dynamic pricing and order automation.
WooCommerce Order Edit - nFusion Meta Box — Per-order sync status, Retail Order ID, and direct link to the nFusion Dashboard
